title: QB1_supplementary#q4 attributed Continuous Machinery Survey to IACS UR Z7/Z7.1; Z7 is Hull classification surveys and machinery is Z18
candidate_claim: Raised by production, not by a candidate. Building the PMS card for AUG-0225 required the correct IACS Unified Requirement. IACS's own consolidated UR Z document was acquired and its contents page contradicts the bank.
rationale: IACS UR Z contents page, read from the publisher's own consolidated 2024 document now held at true-source/07-iacs-and-class/_unified-requirements/: 'Z7 Hull classification surveys'; 'Z18 Survey of machinery, Rev.9 Apr 2020'; 'Z20 Planned maintenance scheme (PMS) for machinery, Rev.2 May 2019'; 'Z27 Condition Monitoring and Condition Based Maintenance'. UR Z18 section 1.3 is Continuous Surveys, 1.5 Planned Maintenance Scheme, 1.6 Condition Monitoring / CBM. Z7 is a hull requirement and has no machinery content whatever. The card asserted 'Under IACS UR Z7/Z7.1, Continuous Machinery Survey is an alternative to the concentrated 5-year Periodical Machinery Survey' and repeated the citation in its practice answer, its reg-box and its tag line - four places in total. The error is pre-existing and was not introduced by this batch.
note: WHY THIS IS IN BOUND. Section 15 of the governing brief says not to absorb previously identified pre-existing defects unless the batch directly modifies that card for a new accepted reason. This is a different situation: the new QB1_F#q23 cites UR Z20 under parent UR Z18, so leaving q4 uncorrected would place two live cards in direct contradiction on a verifiable citation, which is the section 14B pattern - an existing card teaching something contradicted by current authority. The correction is confined to the citation and one added sentence distinguishing Z18, Z20, Z27 and Z7; no other content in the card is touched. NOT DONE: the card's substantive CMS content - reserved items, CE delegation, exclusions - was read and is unaffected.
authority: IACS Unified Requirements Z, consolidated Req. 2024, published by IACS and now held at true-source/07-iacs-and-class/_unified-requirements/IACS_UR_Z_consolidated_2024.pdf. Contents page for the UR numbering; UR Z18 section list for the machinery survey content; UR Z20 for the PMS alternative.

cards.rationale: All four 'IACS UR Z7/Z7.1' and 'IACS UR Z7' citations replaced with UR Z18, and one sentence added stating the distinction: machinery surveys are Z18 (1.3 continuous, 1.5 PMS, 1.6 condition monitoring), the PMS alternative is detailed in Z20, condition-based maintenance in Z27, and Z7 is Hull classification surveys. Cross-reference added to the new QB1_F#q23. v1.3 to v1.4.

propagation.corpus_sweep: Pattern /[^<>]{0,80}Z7[^<>]{0,80}/ over tag-stripped card text, filtered for machinery, CMS, CSM or continuous. Returns TWO matches and both are in QB1_supplementary#q4. No other card in the 86-file bank attributes machinery survey to Z7. After the correction the only residual 'UR Z7' string in that card is the new sentence stating that Z7 is hull classification surveys, which is the correct statement and is intended to remain.
propagation.derived_surfaces: Regenerated by their generators after all H3B-2 edits.
propagation.hand_maintained_surfaces: None specific to this correction; the card count is unchanged.
propagation.revision_layer: QB1_supplementary has no cheat sheet of its own. QB1_FG_CheatSheet covers QB1_F and QB1_G only and carries no UR Z citation, so nothing there becomes wrong.

invariants.new_cards_note: The four new cards in this working tree belong to batch_h3b2_manifest.json. The 752 to 756 movement is that batch's, not this record's; both share the baseline 4a24868 and name each other.

review.round_1_verdict: ACCEPT - no defect found in the correction itself; the reviewer independently verified the UR Z numbering from the IACS contents pages and confirmed Z7 is Hull classification surveys
